current_evidence: Ealing's planning application process pages link only to national requirements and topic pages. The planning.data.gov.uk 'Local area requirements' record (entity 20065, start date 2024-01-01) points to an Ealing 'Planning Application Requirements' document, https://www.ealing.gov.uk/download/downloads/id/4154/full_planning_application_checklist.doc (landing page downloads/download/1383/full_planning_application_checklist). Both returned client_error, so no current list could be confirmed within the call budget.

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is the generic 'Validation' page (page 3 of 7) of Ealing's planning application process guide. It covers validation timescales, invalid applications and tracking, and neither contains nor links a local validation list.
issues.evidence: Page 3: covers 'the council's validation timescale, what happens to invalid applications, and how to track an application online'

issues.detail: The Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong: the page loads normally. It is just not a validation list. The URL also came from a third-party directory (planninggeek.co.uk) and was not verified.
issues.evidence: URL source: 'planninggeek.co.uk directory (third-party; not verified on this run)'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not find the candidate local requirements document (Ealing 'full planning application checklist', download id 4154) recorded on planning.data.gov.uk. The process page 2 also states local expectations that Grokbot did not record: Design and Access Statements and CIL where applicable; viability statements published unredacted and supplied in publishable form at validation; and separate practical guidance for small HMO applications. All application types are left blank.
issues.evidence: Process page 2, 'Supporting documents and validation checklists' section; planning.data.gov.uk entity 20065 'Planning Application Requirements' (London Borough of Ealing)

summary: Grokbot's link is Ealing's generic validation-process web page, not a local validation list, and the 'not readable' status is wrong. The only candidate list (a 'full planning application checklist' .doc on ealing.gov.uk) could not be fetched, so no current list was confirmed and no contents could be checked.
